Person who cannot stop a harmful habit — Adicto/a.
Person who loves something very much — Fanático/a / enganchado/a.
Careful because of possible danger — Cauteloso/a / receloso/a.
Pattern: wary of something. Comparative: warier.
He had the misfortune to lose his keys.
Keep away from someone or something — Evitar / eludir.
v|Pattern: avoid doing something, never avoid to do.
He felt wretched after the news.
Very poor in quality — Pésimo/a / lamentable.
A small barrel — Barrilete / tonel pequeño.
They rolled a keg of beer inside.
Mostly used for beer and nails.
Give someone the food needed to stay healthy — Nutrir / alimentar.
Keep a feeling or idea alive — Alimentar / abrigar.
He nourished a hope of returning.
Add a small quantity of salt.
Plural: quantities. Compare with quality, which is how good it is.
Choose one thing rather than another — Optar / decantarse.
She opted for the cheaper ticket.
v|Patterns: opt for something, opt to do something, opt out of a plan.
A very sad event — Tragedia / desgracia.
The fire was a terrible tragedy.
A serious play with a sad ending — Tragedia.
We read a Greek tragedy at school.
Person walking in the street — Peatón / peatona.
The driver stopped for a pedestrian.
Look at something quickly — Echar un vistazo / mirar de reojo.
A quick look, noun — Vistazo / ojeada.
She gave me a worried glance.
v|Pattern: glance at something. Phrase: at first glance.
A plan for how money will be spent — Presupuesto.
The family keeps a monthly budget.
Plan how to spend money — Presupuestar / administrar.
Cheap; low-priced — Económico/a / de bajo coste.
They stayed in a budget hotel.
v|Phrase: on a budget, meaning with little money.
Able to move quickly and lightly — Ágil / ligero/a.
Her nimble fingers tied the knot.
Quick to think — Despierto/a / ágil de mente.
Handle something with skill — Manipular / manejar.
He manipulated his friends to get the job.
v|Noun: manipulation. The second sense is negative.
Not caring about danger — Imprudente / temerario/a.
He was fined for reckless driving.
Very unpleasant or nasty — Horrible / espantoso/a.
A little old-fashioned; horrible is more common.
Talk wildly and without sense — Desvariar / delirar.
He raved about aliens all night.
Praise something enthusiastically — Deshacerse en elogios.
Not wasting money, time or fuel — Económico/a / ahorrativo/a.
This car is economical to run.
Adverb: economically. Careful: economic is about the economy, economical is about not wasting.
Put oil or grease on something so it moves easily — Lubricar / engrasar.
Lubricate the chain once a month.
Noun: ingenuity. Careful: ingenuous means innocent, which is not the same.
Water is abundant in this region.
Worried and not relaxed — Inquieto/a / intranquilo/a.
I felt uneasy about the plan.
Work something out with numbers — Calcular.
Calculate the total before you pay.
Judge or estimate something — Calcular / estimar.
We calculated that it would take two hours.
Hold someone's whole attention — Absorber / embeber.
Judge roughly the size, cost or value — Estimar / calcular aproximadamente.
They estimate the damage at 10,000 euros.
A rough calculation, noun — Presupuesto / estimación.
v|The verb ends in -eit, the noun in -at.
A very small piece of food — Bocado / trocito.
A tiny amount of anything — Pizca / ápice.
There is not a morsel of truth in it.
A fixed share or limited number allowed — Cuota / cupo.
The country set a quota on imports.
Plural: quotas. Careful: a quota is a share, a quote is repeated words.
A warning that something bad will happen — Amenaza.
He made a threat against the referee.
Pollution is a threat to health.
Sudden fear that stops you thinking — Pánico.
Feel sudden fear — Aterrarse / entrar en pánico.
Don't panic if the lights go out.
v|Note the spelling: panics, panicked, panicking.
Right for the occasion — Apropiado/a / adecuado/a.
Wear appropriate shoes for the walk.
Take something for your own use — Apropiarse de.
A fierce dog guarded the gate.
Very strong or intense — Encarnizado/a / intenso/a.
There is fierce competition for the job.
Too satisfied with yourself to try harder — Complaciente consigo mismo / autocomplaciente.
After one win the team became complacent.
Noun: complacency. False friend: complaciente in Spanish usually means obliging.
A flying insect with a narrow body and a sting — Avispa.
A wasp flew into the kitchen.
Help someone return to a normal life — Rehabilitar / reinsertar.
Restore a building to good condition — Rehabilitar / restaurar.
v|Noun: rehabilitation, often shortened to rehab.
Early release of a prisoner on certain conditions — Libertad condicional.
Release a prisoner on those conditions — Poner en libertad condicional.
She was paroled after four years.
A very large number of people or things — Multitud.
A multitude gathered in the square.
Propose someone for a position or prize — Nominar / proponer.
The film was nominated for three awards.
She was nominated chair of the group.
Possible but not yet real — Potencial / posible.
Ability that could be developed, noun — Potencial.
Place where dead bodies are kept — Depósito de cadáveres / morgue.
The body was taken to the morgue.
Also the old files of a newspaper. The final -ue is silent.
Thinking so much about something that you notice nothing else — Preocupado/a / absorto/a.
She was preoccupied with the exam.
Lack of interest or care — Indiferencia.
He treated the warning with indifference.
Adjective: indifferent. Pattern: indifference to something.
Keep something in good condition — Mantener / conservar.
Continue something at the same level — Mantener.
Say firmly that something is true — Sostener / afirmar.
He maintains that he is innocent.
Treat someone coldly on purpose — Desairar / hacer un desaire.
She snubbed him at the party.
A cold or rude act, noun — Desaire / desprecio.
His silence was a deliberate snub.
v|Also snub-nosed, with a short flat nose.
The w is silent. Literary or formal. Adjective: wrathful.
Uncover something and leave it unprotected — Exponer / dejar al descubierto.
Do not expose the paint to rain.
Make a secret known — Destapar / desenmascarar.
v|Noun: exposure. Pattern: expose someone to something.
An old story many people have believed — Leyenda.
The legend says a dragon lived here.
A very famous person — Leyenda / mito.
She is a legend in the sport.
The words explaining a map or picture — Leyenda.
Check the legend for the symbols.
Think about something carefully for a long time — Reflexionar sobre / meditar.
He pondered the offer for days.
v|Pattern: ponder something or ponder over something.
Give up a job or position — Dimitir / renunciar.
Accept something unpleasant calmly — Resignarse a.
v|The g is silent. Noun: resignation.
Extreme and sudden in effect — Drástico/a / radical.
A platform at the water's edge where ships load — Muelle / embarcadero.
The cargo was left on the wharf.
Plural: wharves or wharfs. The h is silent.
Change something slightly to improve it — Enmendar / modificar.
v|Noun: amendment. Phrase: make amends, meaning to put things right.
A paper or system used for secret voting — Papeleta / votación.
Vote or decide by ballot — Votar / someter a votación.
